title: Raoni Barcelos Stretchered Out After Fierce Fight Against Raul Rosas Jr
seoTitle: Barcelos Stretchered Out After Grueling Fight vs Rosas Jr
subtitle: The Brazilian suffered an injury in the fifth round and was taken to the hospital
excerpt: On the night of September 26, Raoni Barcelos faced Raul Rosas Jr at UFC Vegas 121. The bout ended with the Brazilian collapsing unresponsive, being transported to the.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the night of September 26, UFC Vegas 121 in Las Vegas saw Raoni Barcelos face Raul Rosas Jr. in a bantamweight main event that ended with the Brazilian collapsing unresponsive in the fifth round, being taken to the hospital.

What Happened in the Fight

The fight began with both fighters at maximum pace. Raoni attempted a single-leg takedown but received strikes while clinching, responding with hard blows. The exchange continued in the first two rounds, with both trading heavy shots in the center of the cage. In the third round, Raoni executed a takedown and continued attacking, but Raul escaped, and the fight returned to the feet.

In the fourth round, Raoni again took Raul down, but the Mexican maintained his resistance. In the final round, the battle became frantic. With 30 seconds remaining, Raoni secured Raul in a body lock, who tried to escape, but the Brazilian maintained the pressure. Raul attempted ground and pound strikes, but Raoni no longer had any defense, leading the referee to stop the fight. Raul Rosas Jr. won by technical knockout at 1 minute and 38 seconds of the fifth round.

Injury and Hospital Transport

During the final takedown, Raoni got injured and was no longer able to continue. He was stretchered directly to the hospital, where he received medical attention. The athlete remained conscious after transport.

Raul Rosas Jr.'s Performance

The 21-year-old Mexican started strong and maintained a fast pace. In the fifth round, he returned determined to finish the fight, executing a takedown that caused Raoni to fall unresponsive. This victory was Rosas Jr.'s seventh in eight UFC fights, consolidating his position as one of the biggest prospects in the division.

Other Event Highlights

On the same card, Tina Black became the first Brazilian woman to win The Ultimate Fighter, defeating Melissa Amaya by technical knockout. Rodolfo Vieira and Elves Brener also emerged victorious, completing three Brazilian triumphs at the event.

Conclusion of the Night

The night of UFC Vegas 121 was marked by intense fights and surprising results. While Raoni Barcelos suffered an injury that sent him to the hospital, Raul Rosas Jr. advanced in the rankings with a convincing victory. The event reinforced Brazil's presence in the UFC and the rise of new talents in the organization.
